name: United Kingdom
work_strategy: Remote (Due to high prices and taxes, it is more advantageous to work from outside)
it_market: Excellent (Largest IT market and startup ecosystem in Europe)
ua_fop_and_local_taxes: First 183 days €0 (if non-resident under SRT); thereafter 20–45% Income Tax + National Insurance; Ukrainian 5% Single Tax is not credited under DTT.
climate: Rainy (Temperate, but often overcast, little sun)
nature: Ocean & Hills (Scottish Highlands are beautiful, but the sea is cold)
housing_rent: Expensive (High rents, especially in London and surrounding areas)
citizenship: 6 years (5 years on a work visa + 1 year in ILR status)
mortgage_expats: Difficult (Requires ILR status or a very large down payment)
rent_to_buy: Difficult (Government Shared Ownership/Rent to Buy programs exist, but hard for expats to access)
